text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 418 July 26, 1973
CREATING A GREEN REVOLUTION EXPANDED PROGRAM ACTION COMMITTEE
WHEREAS, there is a need for the Green Revolution Program to continue intensively in order to sustain the
gains so far attained both in terms of additional vegetable production and in the rekindling in our people the
value of labor;
WHEREAS, the most effective means against spiraling of prices would be increasing local production levels
of basic food commodities and their substitutes as well as the production and consumption of supplementary
crops, such as rootcrops and tubers in backyard for home consumption;
WHEREAS, the National Green Revolution Committee with its successful program of promoting backyard
vegetable production can effectively implement an expanded program to include other supplementary crops
with additional assistance;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law do hereby create a Green Revolution Expanded Program Action Committee composed of:
The Chairman, National Green Revolution Committee
The Undersecretary of Education
Vice-Chairman
The Undersecretary for Home Defense, Force
The Assistant Executive Secretary
The Undersecretary for Community Development, DLG
The Executive Director, National Food & Agriculture Council
The Director, Bureau of Plant Industry DANR
The Director, Bureau of Agricultural Extension, DANR
The Committee shall endeavor to enlist the maximum participation of all local government units and the
student population of the nation in the performance of this task. In the execution of its program of activities,
the Committee shall organize action groups at the provincial, city and municipal level.
On the national level, a coordinating center shall be organized which shall act as the clearing house for all the
activities to be undertaken, which shall monitor field operations and centralizing the procurement of needed
supplies and materials required by the program. For this purpose, the Committee shall designate an Executive
Director for the center to be under the direct supervision of the DND Undersecretary for Home Defense and
cooperating agencies shall designate their liaison officers as well as provide the necessary technical personnel
that may be needed to be detailed to the center.
The Committee is hereby authorized to call on any and all agencies and instrumentalities of the government
for assistance in the performance of its formation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-three.
